verdict.rationale: Asana's AI Teammates feature claims 'shared memory' where 'every piece of feedback, every preference gets carried forward,' which loosely maps to personalization, but there's no specific evidence of learning tone, shorthand, or writing style, nor any hands-on validation of this personalization actually working. missing for 10: evidence of tone/style/shorthand learning specifically, first-party detail on how preference adaptation works mechanically, and independent corroboration that AI output actually reflects user's individual style.
